title: How many runs should a coin make?
hook: Two stated cases: explore transitions in an independent sequence.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How transitions in an independent sequence affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines ExpectedRuns, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare transitions in an independent sequence in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
